اعتزلت (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَلْتُ (iʕtazaltu) /iʕ.ta.zal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# اِعْتَزَلْتَ (iʕtazalta) /iʕ.ta.zal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# اِعْتَزَلْتِ (iʕtazalti) /iʕ.ta.zal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# اِعْتَزَلَتْ (iʕtazalat) /iʕ.ta.za.lat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
